name: Aminophylline
mechanism: Phosphodiesterase inhibitor causing bronchodilation and anti-inflammatory effects
dosing: IV loading: 5mg/kg over 20min (if not on theophylline), then 0.5mg/kg/h infusion. Oral: 225-450mg BD
contraindications: Acute porphyria, hyperthyroidism (relative), severe cardiac disease
interactions: Many - CYP1A2 interactions, macrolides, quinolones (↑ levels), smoking (↓ levels)
monitoring: Theophylline levels (target 10-20mg/L), ECG, potassium, signs of toxicity
pregnancy: Use if asthma control requires - neonatal irritability/apnoea possible
pharmacokinetics: Narrow therapeutic index, variable metabolism, levels affected by many factors
clinicalPearls: IV form for acute severe asthma. Therapeutic drug monitoring essential. Many drug interactions
indication: Acute severe asthma (IV), chronic asthma/COPD (oral) when other treatments inadequate
